Satu angka latency tidak cukup untuk men: One latency number is not enough to call a Commerce query improved. How can we design a baseline that separates warmup, cache, concurrency, data volume, and tail latency so p50 and p95 can be read honestly?

Baseline adalah kontrak pengukuran: A baseline is a measurement contract
Baseline bukan satu angka yang ditempelk: A baseline is not a single number attached to a query; it is a workload description and its measurement rules. For a Commerce invoice report, record the same statement, parameters, PostgreSQL and driver versions, relevant configuration, data size, result shape, and whether the request runs alone or alongside other requests. A query over ten thousand rows and one over ten million rows are not the same baseline. The same is true of concurrency one and concurrency ten: they answer different capacity questions. If one candidate uses a prepared statement and another does not, state that difference before comparing numbers. A sufficiently detailed baseline tells readers what was actually measured and when the number must not be transferred to another workload.
Cache dan warmup juga bagian dari kontra: Cache and warmup are also part of the contract. The first run may pay for parsing, planning, page reads, or filling the cache; later runs may be warmer. Do not silently remove the first run and call the rest general performance. Mark warmup and exclude it from the main sample when the goal is steady state, or report cold start as a separate cohort when cold start matters to users. Keep the result of every run, not only the average, because two groups with the same average can have very different tails. A good baseline does not promise that every later run is identical; it is a comparison point with stated conditions, so changes can be traced and repeated safely.
Sampling harus memiliki unit yang jelas:: Sampling must have a clear unit: one sample row represents one completed request execution, with either end-to-end or database duration chosen consistently. Set the run count, excluded warmup, parameter order or randomization, and how errors and timeouts are handled. In this example, p50 and p95 use `percentile_cont`: after durations are sorted, the position for quantile p is `r = 1 + (n - 1) × p`; when r is not an integer, interpolate linearly between the two nearest positions. Under this rule, p50 for eleven samples is position six, while p95 is position 10.5. Other methods such as nearest-rank can produce different numbers, so the method name belongs in the report.
P50 menggambarkan titik tengah sampel, t: P50 describes the midpoint of a sample, but users who experience a slow tail are often better represented by p95. P95 is not the maximum and does not guarantee that 95 percent of production requests finish below the number; it only describes the collected cohort. Eleven samples are enough to practice the calculation, not establish an SLA. For real decisions, collect more samples, separate meaningful parameters and cohorts, record outliers instead of removing them without a rule, and state uncertainty. Do not mix warm and cold, concurrency one and ten, or different data sizes into one percentile, because the result would describe a workload that was never run.

Memisahkan pool wait, database execution: Separate pool wait, database execution, and end-to-end latency without treating query-count reduction as proof of being 100x faster.

Dataset N1 membuat 100 invoice Commerce: Dataset N1 creates 100 Commerce invoices and one `succeeded` payment for each invoice. The batched query uses a `LEFT JOIN` and conditional aggregation, so invoices remain visible and only the correct payments are summed. The `n_plus_one` metadata row states that the application issues one list query plus 100 detail queries after the invoice list, for 101 statements total; the lesson fixture does not send those 100 queries. The `batched_aggregate` row states one statement that retrieves the list and aggregation. Both rows use a summary from the same fixture, 100 paid invoices and total 105050.00, but that summary is not proof that the 101-query request ran or that results are equivalent in all conditions.
N+1 terjadi ketika aplikasi mengambil da: N+1 occurs when an application fetches a parent list with one query and then runs a child query for every row. In an invoice report, one SELECT for 100 invoices followed by 100 payment SELECTs means at least 101 statements and many application-to-database trips. Each SELECT may finish quickly in the database, but every round trip carries serialization, network, connection acquisition, parsing or binding, and application coordination. If an invoice has no payment, the pattern still pays for a trip to obtain an empty result. The fix is not merely renaming an ORM method: a join or aggregation must preserve grain, status filters, and invoices without payments so the result remains correct.
Satu query agregasi dapat mengembalikan: One aggregation query can return 100 summary rows in one round trip, but that does not promise latency 100 times lower. A larger query can use more CPU, memory, locks, or transfer time; a fast network can make N+1 less visible, while a slow network can make it dominant. Compare query count, row count, total database time, payload size, and end-to-end time within the same cohort. Do not replace a LEFT JOIN with an INNER JOIN merely to make the row count look smaller. Correctness still includes invoices without payments, only `succeeded` payments, and totals not duplicated by the join.
Connection pool membatasi berapa banyak: A connection pool limits how many requests can use database connections concurrently; it is not the database server and does not replace `max_connections`. When all pool slots are occupied, a request waits before sending its statement. Measure at least three times: `pool_wait_ms` from requesting a connection until receiving it, `db_time_ms` while the database runs the statement, and `end_to_end_ms` from request start until the response completes. End-to-end can include serialization, network, application queueing, and result processing. Measuring only db_time can hide pool queueing; measuring only end-to-end can mix root causes.
Transaction yang terlalu panjang memegan: An overly long transaction holds a connection and snapshot longer, retains certain locks, and reduces pool capacity for other requests. An unboundedly larger pool can also pressure the server: more backends mean competition for CPU, memory, locks, and I/O, not automatically higher throughput. `max_connections` is a server limit, while a client pool should account for application workers and other workloads. Open a transaction close to the database operations that need consistency, do not wait for HTTP or unnecessary CPU work inside it, and do not naively split an atomic business operation merely to shorten a duration.

Membedakan bukti before/after authored d: Distinguish authored before/after evidence from a live benchmark and reject an optimization that is fast but changes the result.
Menjelaskan mengapa certification adalah: Explain why certification is a decision bounded by scope and time, not a claim that a query is always fast in production.
Performance certification adalah keputus: Performance certification is a rubric-based decision, not a stamp for the fastest number. A candidate must meet the stated target, such as p95 no more than 200 ms for a particular cohort, while returning a correct and equivalent result. Result equivalence must compare grain, order when contracted, NULLs, duplicates, and the same filters; a query that removes empty invoices does not pass merely because p95 fell. The p95 target must also state the sample method, repetition count, warmup policy, parameters, concurrency, data size, and timeout. Without that scope, the word ‘pass’ hides which workload question was actually satisfied.
Plan before/after memberi konteks peruba: Before/after plans provide change context: operators, estimated rows, actual evidence when available, relevant indexes, sorts, joins, and buffers. Record the PostgreSQL version, session/server configuration affecting the plan, cache state, statistics, data snapshot, and schema changes. Safety includes a disposable fixture or explicit change permission, a rollback plan for mutations, and a prohibition on measuring dangerous statements in production without a procedure. This lesson presents authored evidence for rubric practice; it runs no live benchmark, certifies no query, and provides no evidence that the table's numbers represent any server.
Sertifikasi juga harus menyebut apa yang: Certification must also state what is outside scope. A p95 target for one parameter and concurrency does not automatically apply to other parameters, a cold cache, a full pool, or grown data. If the query uses a new index, record the DDL, predicate, maintenance cost, and changed plan; if the rewrite changes the transaction boundary, record isolation and lock behavior. Before and after do not need identical plans—the plan change may be the goal—but evidence must be sufficient to explain the change. With explicit scope, ‘certified’ means passing the rubric under particular conditions, not a promise of permanent performance.
Paket evidence minimal menyimpan baris b: A minimal evidence package stores before and after rows for the same candidate. Before gives the baseline p95 and comparison context; after records p95, target, sample count, result_equivalent, plan_captured, config_same, data_snapshot_same, repeated, and safety_reviewed. `plan_captured` means plan context is available, not that a particular operator is necessarily faster. `config_same` and `data_snapshot_same` prevent a numeric improvement from silently coming from changed conditions. `repeated` marks that the sample is not one run. Every boolean must be traceable to an allowed note or artifact, not filled with true to make a candidate pass.
Keputusan dapat diringkas sebagai certif: A decision may be summarized as certified only when after meets the p95 target and every correctness, plan-context, configuration, data, repetition, and safety guard is true. A candidate with p95 120 ms but result_equivalent false must be rejected. A candidate that is correct and meets the target but does not store before/after plans or prove equal configuration is also not certified; it may be a hypothesis to remeasure. This rubric is deliberately conservative because an optimization that is hard to explain is hard to reproduce and recover from when the workload changes.
Untuk tujuan “kurangi p95”, after juga h: For the goal ‘reduce p95,’ after must also be lower than before in a comparable cohort; meeting an absolute target without attributable improvement does not explain the candidate's benefit. Both phases need enough sample_count and context evidence, not only an after selected because it happened to be good. Use reject or pending when evidence is missing rather than forcing a boolean true. If the 200 ms target is met but p95 rises from 180 to 190, the candidate may still meet the target but does not prove improvement over baseline; the report must distinguish those two questions.
Baca keputusan authored dengan batas sco: Read the authored decision within its scope
Dataset C1 berisi tiga candidate: `idx_i: Dataset C1 contains three candidates: `idx_invoice_student` reaches authored p95 160 ms against a 200 ms target with every guard true; `fast_rewrite` reaches 120 ms but result_equivalent is false; `cache_only` reaches 150 ms with a correct result but plan_captured is false. The reference query joins before and after and computes the decision from the rubric conditions. Only the first candidate is labeled `certified` in the example. That label means it satisfies the authored-data rules for the lesson cohort, not production certification and not a prediction that p95 will remain the same after data, cache, concurrency, or version changes.
Setelah keputusan, simpan query text, pa: After the decision, store query text, parameters, before/after results, plan artifacts, configuration, data snapshot, run count, warmup, errors, and safety review in auditable notes. Re-run when the schema, index, PostgreSQL version, pool, resource limits, or data distribution changes. Certification also needs an expiry or owner when used in real operations. Do not force global planner settings or sacrifice correctness to meet the target; when the target fails, report the regression and next hypothesis. No Dataset C1 number may be presented as latency we measured.
Checklist ini tidak menggantikan review: This checklist does not replace human review of the query and data. Authored results can help check whether the rubric is internally consistent, but only authorized measurement and auditable evidence can support an operational decision. If before and after use different fixtures, different parameters, or unrecorded sampling errors, mark the result as incomparable. If a schema or index change has deployment risk, performance certification does not remove the need for a migration plan, rollback, and ownership.
Dataset C1 — authored before/after rubri: Dataset C1 — authored before/after rubric for three invoice candidates. p95, sample_count, plan/config/data/repeat/safety flags, and decisions are written for audit practice, not a live benchmark or production certification.
Reference query menghitung keputusan dar: The reference query computes the decision from the p95 target, after < before improvement, a minimum sample_count of 10 in both phases, baseline context, and after guards. `cache_only` fails because plan_captured is false; `fast_rewrite` fails because result_equivalent is false even though p95 is 120.00; only `idx_invoice_student` meets every authored condition. The certified label is limited to Dataset C1 and this rubric. It is not a live benchmark result, production evidence, or a statement that the plan or latency will remain the same after workload conditions change.
Candidate after memiliki p95 120 ms dari: An after candidate has p95 120 ms against a 200 ms target but result_equivalent = false. What does the rubric decide?
Certified karena target p95 adalah satu-: Certified because the p95 target is the only objective requirement.
Certified sementara; correctness boleh d: Temporarily certified; correctness can be fixed after deployment.
Reject, karena perbaikan latency tidak l: Reject, because a latency improvement does not pass when the query result changes from the contract.
Rubric mensyaratkan target dan hasil eku: The rubric requires both the target and equivalent results. A fast but incorrect candidate cannot be certified.
Belum tepat. Target p95 hanyalah satu gu: Not quite. The p95 target is only one of several requirements.
Belum tepat. Menunda correctness meminda: Not quite. Deferring correctness moves the bug to users and is not certification.
Benar. Correctness adalah guard kritis y: Correct. Correctness is a critical guard that cannot be traded for latency.
Mengapa config_same dan data_snapshot_sa: Why are config_same and data_snapshot_same required in before/after evidence?
Agar penurunan p95 tidak diam-diam beras: So a p95 reduction does not secretly come from changed configuration or dataset.
Agar semua plan harus memiliki operator: So every plan must have byte-for-byte identical operators.
Agar satu run after dapat menggantikan s: So one after run can replace every before repetition.
Perbandingan yang adil perlu menjaga kon: A fair comparison keeps conditions that affect the planner and latency while allowing the plan change actually being tested.
Benar. Catat konteks yang sama sehingga: Correct. Record the same context so a change is more likely to come from the candidate being tested.
Belum tepat. Plan boleh berubah; yang pe: Not quite. The plan may change; what matters is recording plan context and keeping results correct.
Belum tepat. Repetisi before dan after t: Not quite. Before and after repetitions are still needed to understand the distribution.
Terapkan rubric Dataset C1. Pilih candid: Apply the Dataset C1 rubric. Choose the candidate that actually meets the p95 target, result equivalence, plan context, config/data parity, repetition, and safety.
TEMP table berisi pasangan before/after: The TEMP table contains before/after pairs for three invoice candidates. Every flag is authored evidence to read, not a live benchmark result. The `certified` decision applies only to the 200 ms target, sample 12, and stated cohort; do not turn the label into a production claim.
Candidate A mencapai target p95 dan hasi: Candidate A meets the p95 target and equivalent results, but after has no plan capture. What is its status?
Certified karena plan tidak pernah memen: Certified because plans never affect reproducibility.
Belum certified; simpan evidence plan be: Not certified yet; store before/after plan evidence and remeasure before the final decision.
Certified jika pool dinaikkan agar angka: Certified if the pool is increased to make the number lower.
Target dan correctness belum cukup bila: Target and correctness are insufficient when the rubric requires plan context. Missing evidence must result in reject or pending, not certified.
Belum tepat. Plan context membantu menje: Not quite. Plan context helps explain the change and its generalization limits.
Benar. Candidate perlu evidence lengkap: Correct. The candidate needs complete evidence before passing the rubric.
Belum tepat. Mengubah pool tanpa evidenc: Not quite. Changing the pool without new evidence does not provide a plan capture.
After p95 190 ms memenuhi target 200 ms,: After p95 190 ms meets the 200 ms target, but the data snapshot changed from before. What is the safest conclusion?
Belum dapat mengaitkan perbaikan dengan: The improvement cannot yet be attributed to the candidate; repeat with a comparable data snapshot or state a new scope.
Certified karena p95 di bawah target apa: Certified because p95 is below target regardless of the data.
Reject permanen karena data tidak boleh: Permanently reject because data must never change in any experiment.
Data parity diperlukan untuk perbandinga: Data parity is needed for an attributable comparison; changed data requires a newly stated cohort and target.
Benar. Data berbeda mengubah pertanyaan;: Correct. Different data changes the question; repeat or limit the claim to the new data scope.
Belum tepat. Target tanpa konteks data t: Not quite. A target without data context is insufficient for certification.
Belum tepat. Data boleh berubah pada wor: Not quite. Data may change in a real workload, but the comparison must state its scope and design.
Optimizer memberi p95 bagus pada satu ru: The optimizer gives a good p95 on one run, but after sample_count = 1. What does the rubric do?
Certified karena satu run lebih murni da: Certified because one run is purer than many runs.
Certified bila operator plan terlihat ca: Certified if the plan operator looks sophisticated.
Belum certified; repetisi dan metode sam: Not certified yet; repetition and the sampling method must be evidenced before p95 can be used as a target.
Satu run tidak menunjukkan distribusi at: One run does not show a repeatable distribution or tail. The rubric requires repetition evidence.
Belum tepat. Satu run rentan noise dan t: Not quite. One run is vulnerable to noise and does not describe p95.
Belum tepat. Nama operator bukan bukti s: Not quite. An operator name is not evidence of workload stability.
Benar. Lengkapi sample, warmup policy, d: Correct. Complete the sample, warmup policy, and percentile method.
Profiling dilakukan dengan UPDATE pada d: Profiling was done with UPDATE on real data without a safety review. Even if p95 meets the target, its status is ...
Certified karena target performa mengala: Certified because the performance target outweighs data risk.
Belum certified; safety review adalah gu: Not certified yet; safety review is a separate guard and mutations require an approved procedure.
Certified jika output SELECT sesudahnya: Certified if the later SELECT output looks correct.
Performance evidence tidak menghapus ris: Performance evidence does not remove mutation risk. Safety and correctness are certification requirements.
Belum tepat. Target latency tidak member: Not quite. A latency target does not grant permission to damage data.
Benar. Hentikan klaim certification samp: Correct. Stop the certification claim until safety evidence and scope are repaired.
Belum tepat. Pemeriksaan sesudah mutasi: Not quite. A check after the mutation does not undo a side effect that already occurred.
Mulai dari target p95, lalu centang resu: Start with the p95 target, then check result_equivalent and every evidence guard; one false value prevents certified.
Bedakan missing evidence dari evidence f: Distinguish missing evidence from false evidence: neither supports certification, but the next action may be capture or rerun.
Tulis scope cohort, plan, config, data,: Write the cohort scope, plan, configuration, data, repetition, and safety; do not call Dataset C1 a benchmark or live certification.
Rubric memberi certified hanya pada idx_: The rubric gives certified only to idx_invoice_student because after p95 160.00 <= 200.00, lower than before 240.00, both sample_count values of 12 meet the minimum, and every context/guard is true. cache_only meets p95 and correctness but lacks plan_captured. fast_rewrite meets p95 but has result_equivalent false. Every decision is a reading of an authored table; the lesson creates no live benchmark, runtime EXPLAIN, or production certification.
Jelaskan mengapa p95 yang turun tidak cu: Explain why a lower p95 is not enough for certification, how before/after preserves result equivalence and plan/config/data context, why repetition and safety are required, and why the Dataset C1 label must not be read as a production benchmark.
Kuantil juga sensitif terhadap definisi: Quantiles are also sensitive to the sample definition. If duration is taken on the application side, document when the timer starts and stops, whether response serialization is included, and how cancellation is handled. If only database time is measured, do not call it the user experience. Keep parameters representing both common and heavy cases, because parameters can change selectivity and the planner path. Set resource limits and do not change global settings merely to make one number look better. Simple notes about version, data, cache, concurrency, and samples let a reviewer repeat the same question without guessing missing assumptions.
Jangan menafsirkan tabel ini sebagai uru: Do not interpret this table as a cold-then-warm sequence that necessarily occurs on every server. Cache can change because of other workloads, autovacuum, restart, or eviction; concurrency can change queueing and interleaving. Cohort notes provide language for comparing conditions, not a single cause. To conclude that a candidate is better, state a hypothesis, measure before and after under comparable conditions, and keep enough evidence to check the result set. Without those steps, the numbers are only an example of calculating and reporting a distribution.
ORM sering menyembunyikan N+1 di seriali: ORMs often hide N+1 in serializers, lazy properties, or template loops, so reading repository SQL alone is not enough. An allowed driver trace or log should connect request_id to statements and parameters without exposing sensitive data. A batched query may also need pagination so the payload does not grow without bound. Choose aggregation that returns the required contract, not every detail merely because statement count falls. The main lesson is to reduce trips while preserving grain and invariants, then measure the new cost in a safe environment.
Pool wait dan database time harus dicata: Pool wait and database time should be recorded with a consistent clock. If a pool timeout occurs before a statement is sent, it is not a database error; if the database waits for a lock, db_time can be large even with low CPU. End-to-end includes both as well as application work after receiving the result. Use explicit timeouts and cancellation, then distinguish failed requests from requests that completed slowly. With this separation, increasing the pool can be tested as a bounded hypothesis rather than a universal recipe that sacrifices server resources.
Jika fixture mempunyai invoice tanpa pay: If the fixture has an invoice without a payment, a correct batched result must return paid_total zero or NULL according to the contract, not remove the invoice. If there are two succeeded payments, the amount must be summed exactly once; if there is a failed status, FILTER must keep it out. These small cases can intentionally be checked from SQL, but the player does not run an application or pool trace. Therefore the lesson's conclusion stops at query shape, expected invariants, and a design for further measurement.
Scope yang baik juga menyebut pemilik ke: A good scope also names the decision owner and validity period. Indexes, statistics, pools, versions, and data distributions change; certification without expiry can survive as folklore after its premises disappear. Store the target and why it was chosen, not only the final number. If before and after differ because data intentionally changed, treat it as a new cohort with a new question, not a comparison silently labeled improvement. This lets reviewers distinguish a candidate regression from an environmental change.
Minimum sample_count sepuluh pada SQL in: The minimum sample_count of ten in this SQL is a pedagogical guard so one run is not treated as p95; it is not a universal statistical threshold. In real operations, choose sample count and confidence appropriate to the workload, error rate, and decision at stake. Ensure before and after use the same percentile method, warmup policy, and recorded timeouts/errors without hiding them. If either phase lacks samples, the decision should be pending or reject, not certified merely because after looks low.
Baca keputusan `certified` sebagai “lulu: Read `certified` as ‘passes the written criteria’ and always display those criteria with the label. Do not copy the label to a global dashboard without the cohort, timestamp, and owner. If the customer-facing target changes, review the rubric; if a candidate only reduces database time while pool wait rises, the end-to-end question has not passed. In this way certification becomes a reviewable decision artifact, not a metaphysical claim that PostgreSQL will always be fast.
